Population.evidence_source: The text refers to participants as 'Miss C', 'Mrs S', 'Miss F', and 'Mrs K', indicating the sample consists of women, not men. The review focuses on male suicide risk and recovery factors.

Type.evidence_source: The text describes participant accounts and findings from the study, such as 'Accounts were presented with great sadness and desperation' and 'Accounts were full of surprise and excitement', indicating direct data collection for this study.

Area.evidence_source: Risk: [page/6/Text/22] Prior to the attempt, the experience of becoming less visible to others was characterised by feelings of isolation, loneliness and a general sense of being distanced from and less connected with the outside world, losing friends and loved ones and witnessing a diminishing social circle and detachment from the wider community. Recovery: [page/7/Text/8] Alongside the optimistic accounts of regaining control and the absence of struggle following an attempt was a growing sense of connectedness with others and a re-integration into society as some participants described becoming visible again.
